about: SABA Bench personas. Each plants facts over several sessions (with distractor chats and a life update), then asks probes in fresh incognito chats. `expect` is a list of groups; a probe passes when every group has at least one match (case-insensitive) and no `forbid` term appears. Probe types: recall (stated once), cross (combines sessions), update (a fact changed), temporal (what was true before), moment (something from a past chat that was never a fact about the user — only semantic recall can bring it back), abstain (never said — the right answer is not knowing).

personas.name: Priya
sessions: Hi! I'm Priya, a product designer at a fintech startup in Bengaluru.
My sister Ananya's birthday is on May 3 and she loves orchids.
I'm vegetarian, and I'm allergic to cashews.
Can you explain what a Roth IRA is, briefly?
I've started training for the Mumbai half-marathon in January.
My dog is a beagle named Biscuit.
Give me three tips for writing clearer emails.
Big news — I just moved from Bengaluru to Pune for a new job at Freshworks.
Also, I quit coffee; it's green tea for me now.

probes.q: What do I do for work, and what's my name?
What's my dog called and what breed is it?
I want to buy my sister a birthday present — any idea what she'd like?
Suggest a snack for my long run this weekend that suits my diet.
Which city do I live in now?
What do I drink in the morning these days?
Where did I live before my current city?
Which kind of retirement account did you explain to me a while ago?
What kind of writing did I ask you for tips on recently?
